```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
latest <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(date == max(date))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(latest, aes(region, rate)) +
  geom_col()
```
